body.value: The returned row says it directly: 218,814,471.66 USD is all the money Contoso actually charged its customers, after discount, across every shop it has on record, over the whole ten years the data covers — the row's own first_order 2016-05-18 and last_order 2025-12-31 are that window, and its 223,974 sales_lines are every order line in the warehouse. The 64 in stores_with_sales is how many of the 74 recorded premises ever rang up a sale; the other 10 are still in the population and simply added nothing. BOTH channels are inside this one number: 132,024,417.53 from the 73 walk-in shops and 86,790,054.13 from the single web shop. WHAT IS NOT IN IT: no exclusion of any kind was applied, so the 3,205,452.33 earned by the 16 shops that have since closed is counted; but being NET it leaves out the 13,787,071.00 of discounts given away, the before-discount figure being 232,601,542.66. It is one combined chain total, not a figure per store, and the amounts are USD as stored, with no currency conversion.

SELECT
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM contoso_served.dim_store
  ) AS store_rows_all,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM contoso_served.dim_store
    WHERE
      store_name LIKE 'Contoso%'
  ) AS rows_named_contoso,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM contoso_served.dim_store
    WHERE
      store_name NOT LIKE 'Contoso%'
  ) AS rows_not_named_contoso,
  (
    SELECT
      LISTAGG(DISTINCT store_name, ' | ')
    FROM contoso_served.dim_store
    WHERE
      store_name NOT LIKE 'Contoso%'
  ) AS the_non_contoso_names,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM contoso_served.dim_store
    WHERE
      location_code <> -1
  ) AS rows_physical,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM contoso_served.dim_store
    WHERE
      location_code = -1
  ) AS rows_online,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM contoso_served.dim_store
    WHERE
      close_date IS NULL
  ) AS rows_active,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM contoso_served.dim_store
    WHERE
      NOT close_date IS NULL
  ) AS rows_closed,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT location_code)
    FROM contoso_served.dim_store
  ) AS distinct_sites,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(DISTINCT brand)
    FROM contoso_served.dim_product
  ) AS brands_in_catalogue,
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM contoso_served.dim_product
    WHERE
      brand = 'Contoso'
  ) AS products_of_brand_contoso
